name: Ampara Paddy Farm

name: Lahugala Organic Garden
description: Discover the lush Lahugala Organic Garden, nestled in the Ampara district. This serene estate offers a glimpse into traditional tea cultivation practices, surrounded by vibrant greenery and tranquil ponds. Experience the harmonious blend of nature and craftsmanship here.
